title: European Commission proposes tax on Big Tech to boost EU budget
detail: The European Commission has proposed a tax on large technology companies as a new revenue source for the EU budget, according to The Hindu. Details of the levy's design and approval path were not available in the source summary; such own-resource proposals generally require unanimity in the Council.
